title: Getting Started
content: Welcome to NovaTech! To get started, visit app.novatech.io and click Sign Up. Fill in your full name, email address, and a strong password. After signing up, check your email inbox for a verification link and click it to activate your account. Once verified, log in using your email and password. You will be guided through the onboarding wizard which helps you set up your first workspace, choose your plan, invite team members, and configure your notification preferences. If you do not receive the verification email within 5 minutes, check your spam folder or click Resend Verification Email on the login page.

title: Reset Password
content: To reset your password at NovaTech, follow these steps. Step 1: Go to app.novatech.io and click the Forgot Password link below the login form. Step 2: Enter your registered email address and click Send Reset Link. Step 3: Check your email inbox for a password reset email from NovaTech. Step 4: Click the Reset Password button in the email. Step 5: Enter your new password twice to confirm it. Your new password must be at least 8 characters long and must include at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one special character such as @ or #. The reset link expires in 30 minutes. If you did not receive the email, check your spam folder. If you are already logged in and want to change your password, go to Settings, click Security, then click Change Password and enter your current password followed by your new password.

title: Account Login Issues
content: If you are having trouble logging into your NovaTech account, here are the solutions. If you forgot your password, click Forgot Password on the login page and follow the reset steps. If you see an error saying your account is locked, it means you have entered the wrong password more than 5 times. Wait 15 minutes and try again or reset your password. If you see invalid credentials error, make sure you are using the correct email address and check that Caps Lock is not turned on. If two-factor authentication is enabled on your account, enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app after entering your password. If you cannot access your authenticator app, click Use Backup Code and enter one of your saved backup codes. If none of these solutions work, contact support at support@novatech.io.

title: Billing and Subscription Plans
content: NovaTech offers three pricing plans to suit different needs. The Free plan is completely free and includes up to 3 users, 5 projects, 1GB storage, and community support. The Pro plan costs $29 per month and includes unlimited users, unlimited projects, 50GB storage, priority email support, and advanced analytics. The Enterprise plan costs $99 per month and includes everything in Pro plus custom integrations, dedicated account manager, SLA guarantee of 99.9% uptime, SSO login, and phone support. To upgrade your plan, log in and go to Settings, then click Billing, and select your desired plan and enter your payment details. To downgrade your plan, go to Settings, click Billing, and select a lower plan. Your current plan remains active until the end of the billing period. To cancel your subscription, go to Settings, click Billing, and click Cancel Subscription. You will not be charged after cancellation but your account remains active until the end of the current period. Refunds are available within 14 days of purchase by contacting support@novatech.io.

title: Account Deletion
content: To permanently delete your NovaTech account, follow these steps carefully. Step 1: Log in to your account and go to Settings. Step 2: Click on Account tab. Step 3: Scroll down to the Danger Zone section. Step 4: Click the Delete Account button. Step 5: A confirmation dialog will appear asking you to type your email address to confirm deletion. Step 6: Type your email address exactly and click Confirm Delete. Important warnings before deleting: Account deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. All your data including projects, files, messages, and team history will be permanently erased within 30 days. If you are the owner of a team, you must transfer ownership or delete the team before deleting your account. Make sure to export all your important data before proceeding. To export your data before deletion, go to Settings, click Privacy, then click Export My Data and you will receive a download link within 24 hours.

title: API Access and Developer Integration
content: NovaTech provides a powerful REST API for developers to integrate with their applications. To get started with the API, follow these steps. Step 1: Log in to your NovaTech account. Step 2: Go to Settings and click on Developer. Step 3: Click API Keys and then click Generate New API Key. Step 4: Give your API key a name and select the permissions it needs. Step 5: Copy and save your API key securely as it will only be shown once. API rate limits are as follows: Free plan allows 1000 requests per hour, Pro plan allows 10000 requests per hour, and Enterprise plan allows unlimited requests. If you exceed the rate limit you will receive a 429 error. The full API documentation is available at docs.novatech.io and includes examples for all endpoints. NovaTech supports integrations with Slack for notifications, GitHub for code tracking, Jira for issue management, and Zapier for workflow automation. To set up webhooks for real-time notifications, go to Settings, click Developer, then click Webhooks and enter your endpoint URL.

title: Data Security and Privacy
content: NovaTech takes data security and privacy very seriously. All data stored on NovaTech servers is encrypted at rest using AES-256 encryption. All data transmitted between your browser and NovaTech servers is encrypted using TLS 1.3 protocol. NovaTech is SOC 2 Type II certified and fully GDPR compliant. To enable two-factor authentication for extra security, go to Settings, click Security, then click Enable Two-Factor Authentication and scan the QR code with your authenticator app such as Google Authenticator. To view your login activity and check for unauthorized access, go to Settings, click Security, and then click Login History. NovaTech does not sell user data to third parties under any circumstances. To download all your personal data, go to Settings, click Privacy, then click Export My Data and you will receive a download link via email within 24 hours. To manage which cookies NovaTech uses, click the Cookie Settings link in the footer of the website.

title: Team Collaboration and Member Management
content: NovaTech makes it easy to collaborate with your team. To invite a new team member, follow these steps. Step 1: Go to Settings and click Team. Step 2: Click the Invite Member button. Step 3: Enter the email address of the person you want to invite. Step 4: Choose their role from Admin, Editor, or Viewer. Admins can manage billing, team settings, and have full access to all projects. Editors can create, edit, and delete projects and files. Viewers have read-only access and cannot make any changes. Step 5: Click Send Invitation. The invited person will receive an email invitation valid for 48 hours. If they do not accept within 48 hours, you can resend the invitation from the Team settings page. To change a team member role, go to Settings, click Team, find the member and click the three dots next to their name, then select Change Role. To remove a team member, go to Settings, click Team, find the member and click the three dots next to their name, then select Remove Member. Removed members immediately lose access to all projects.

title: Customer Support and Contact
content: NovaTech offers multiple ways to get help and support. For Free plan users, support is available through the community forum at community.novatech.io where you can post questions and get answers from other users and NovaTech staff. For Pro plan users, email support is available 24 hours a day 7 days a week with an average response time of under 2 hours. Email support at support@novatech.io. Live chat support is available for Pro users Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm Eastern Time by clicking the Help icon in the bottom left corner of the dashboard. For Enterprise plan users, phone support is available 24 hours a day 7 days a week with an average response time of under 30 minutes. Enterprise users also have a dedicated account manager who can be contacted directly. To submit a support ticket for any plan, go to the Help Center at help.novatech.io and click Submit a Request. Include as much detail as possible including screenshots and error messages to get faster help.

title: File and Storage Management
content: NovaTech provides cloud storage for all your project files. To upload a file to a project, open the project, click the Files tab, and click Upload File or drag and drop files into the file area. Supported file types include documents, images, videos, spreadsheets, and PDFs. The maximum file size for a single upload is 100MB for Free and Pro plans and 1GB for Enterprise plan. To download a file, click on the file name and click the Download button. To delete a file, click the three dots next to the file name and click Delete. Deleted files go to the Trash folder and are permanently deleted after 30 days. To restore a deleted file, go to the Trash folder within 30 days and click Restore. Storage limits are 1GB for Free plan, 50GB for Pro plan, and unlimited for Enterprise plan. To check how much storage you are using, go to Settings and click Storage. If you are running low on storage, you can upgrade your plan or delete old unused files.
